item.title: GLASTONBURY’S ARCADIA STAGE TO RUN ENTIRELY OFF RENEWABLE ENERGY IN 2023
item.description: Glastonbury Festival’s world-renowned Arcadia spider stage is set to run entirely off renewable energy at this year’s event. It marks a first for the collective, which hosts stages at festivals around the world including Nevada’s Burning Man and Bangkok’s Gravity Thailand. Announcing the news alongside the stage’s full line-up in May, Arcadia [...]

item.title: NEW DOCUMENTARY EXPLORES THE EUROPEAN FREE PARTY MOVEMENT
item.description: A new documentary, F[R]EE: Behind The Scenes Of The Free Party Movement, is exploring Europe’s free party movement. With screenings starting this week in cinemas across the UK, the new film from Doc’n Roll gives an insight to tekno free parties including Desert Storm and Spiral Tribe. item.title: BERLIN INTRODUCES FREE AND ANONYMOUS DRUG TESTING
item.description: Berlin has officially launched a legal drug testing scheme, allowing people to anonymously get drugs tested for free. The Senate Department for Health announced the new scheme, named Drug Checking, which carried out by The State Institute for Forensic and Social Medicine with three advice centres open. item.description: SHDW & Obscure Shape have announced their curated one-day festival, From Another Mind, set to kick off on August 5. item.title: A NEW ANTHOLOGY OF DISCO CLASSICS BY SYLVESTER IS OUT NOW
item.description: A new anthology of music by disco legend Sylvester has been released via Real Gone Music and Second Disc Records. The 26-track compilation, titled ‘Disco Heat: The Fantasy Years 1977-1981’, is spread over two CDs and features music he released on San Francisco label Fantasy. item.title: NEW SCHEME SET UP TO HELP YOUNG PEOPLE WHO CAN’T AFFORD MUSIC FESTIVALS
item.description: A new crowdfunding scheme aiming to support young people to attend music festivals has been set up by the Association of Independent Festivals (AIF). item.title: 74-YEAR-OLD IBIZA-LOVING MAN IS SAID TO HAVE A “TERRIFYING” CLUB SCHEDULE
item.description: Robert Johnson, a 74-year-old man hailing from Birkenhead, near Liverpool, is said to have a club schedule that would rival any young person.
